text: Which two activities use most of the water used in an average U.S. household? flushing toilets and washing clothes.
When a transverse wave passes from right to left through a medium, what happens to the particles of the medium? Particles move back and forth perpendicular to the wave..
A wind turbine primarily uses which type of energy? mechanical.

The sun is a star of average size and brightness. From Earth, the sun appears as a round, yellow object in the daytime sky. At night, we see other stars. They appear as tiny points of light. Why does the sun appear larger than stars that we see at night? The sun is closer to Earth than other stars, making the sun appear larger..
The smallest unit of a plant that can perform all of the processes of life is the cell..

In Costa Rica a small tree, the acacia, provides shelter and food for ants. The ants protect the acacia by removing other insects and vines that might harm it. Which term best describes the relationship between the acacia and the ants? mutualism.

The Florida Bog Frog (Lithobates okaloosae) inhabits shallow stream overflows in three counties in Florida. With such a small geographic habitat, any change in the frog's environment could cause drastic changes in the population. Which would most likely affect the frog population if acid rain changed the pH of the water? Tadpoles would be unable to survive..

During an ice age, enormous ice sheets called glaciers increase in size on Earth's surface, resulting in decreased ocean depths. Due to global cooling, the water cycle is disrupted between which two stages to cause an increase in glacier size? precipitation and runoff.
Light enters the human eye through the pupil..
When Isaac Newton theorized that gravity caused objects to fall to the ground, he had also discovered the force that causes the planets to orbit the Sun..
During which process does a caterpillar become a butterfly? metamorphosis.

A student conducts an experiment using a common but potentially harmful bacteria culture. After working with the bacteria, which is the most important safety practice to follow? wash hands and tabletops thoroughly.
Which set contains kingdoms that contain only heterotrophs? Animals, Fungi.
What carries oxygen throughout the body? red blood cells.
Which will most likely happen to a solid substance that is heated? It will melt..

Paleontologists often find and study the remains of ancient plants and animals. When the remains of ancient plants and animals are covered by layers of sediment over time, the remains become a fossil.
Sophie investigates the water supply at her school and the things that affect it. Which action is a direct observation? tasting water from a water fountain.
Which would provide evidence of seafloor spreading? cooled magma found on the edge of the plates.
All living organisms are dependent on plants because plants are producers.
Which of the following is most responsible for the decay of dead organisms? microorganisms.
What energy transformation occurs when an electric lamp is turned on? electrical energy to light and heat energy.

Photovoltaic cells capture photons of sunlight and transform them directly into electricity. Many of Earth's other energy resources are simply transformed solar energy. Which two energy resources store energy that did not begin as solar energy? nuclear and geothermal.

Base your answer on the information below and on your knowledge of science. A baseball strikes the roof of a car and dents it. The paint on the roof begins to crack and chip, exposing the metal. The exposed metal on the roof rusts, eventually causing a small hole in the roof. Which event is a chemical change? The exposed metal rusts..
Gaseous sulfur dioxide is a compound that combines with water in the atmosphere to form acid rain. What is the primary source of sulfur dioxide? combustion of fossil fuels.
Which of the following statements best explains why stars appear to move across Earth's sky each night? Earth rotates on its axis..
A device that converts light energy into electricity used in many handheld calculators is a photovoltaic cell..
The continuous changes of a seed to an adult plant that produces seeds is known as a life cycle..
What is the process called when an acid and a base combine to produce water and salt? neutralization.

Repeated pesticide use on an insect population can result in some of the insects becoming resistant to that pesticide over time. Which process is responsible for the pesticides no longer being effective on the insects? natural selection.

Biologists have discovered that the beluga whales of Canada's St. Lawrence River have the highest rates of cancer among animals. What is most likely the reason for this high incidence of cancer in these whales? chemical and pollutant runoff into the ocean.
What is made when sugar is dissolved in water? a solution.
What two gases make up most of the Earth's atmosphere? Oxygen and nitrogen.

Kendall studied the ways in which human body systems work together. He compared the respiratory and circulatory systems. In which way are these two systems similar to each other? They both bring oxygen to the body..
How are the functions of a carbohydrate and a lipid similar? Both are a source of energy..
As the population of small fish in a lake decreases, the population of large fish that depend on the small fish for food will decrease in number.
The nucleus of MOST atoms consists of protons and neutrons.
A soccer player kicks a soccer ball across a field. Which factor has the most effect on the distance the soccer ball travels? the force of the kick.
Traits are transferred from generation to generation through the sperm and the egg.
The surface of the Moon is covered with craters. Most of these craters were formed by the impacts of many meteoroids.
Some machines can remove the salt that is in seawater. How does removing salt from seawater most help people? provides useable drinking water.
Living cells synthesize long chains of amino acids called proteins. Which substance provides the information needed to correctly sequence the amino acids during protein synthesis? DNA.

Many types of organisms live in a meadow. With the introduction of a large, swift-moving predator into the meadow ecosystem, which group of organisms will MOST likely have an advantage of surviving and reproducing? rabbits that can run the fastest.
Which sense is used to determine an object's texture? touch.
Which of the following groups of organisms uses sunlight to convert carbon dioxide and water into sugar and oxygen? producers.

A student wraps a wire around an iron nail. The student then connects the wire to a battery. The nail attracts another nail and they stick together. What force holds the two nails together? magnetic force.
What types of cells are found only in organisms that reproduce sexually? gametes.
When can producers make the most food? summer, because there is more sunlight.

When a cold front moves over a land region that has warm, moist air, a transfer of energy occurs. Cold air sinks and pushes warmer air upward. As energy is removed from the air, which change will most likely take place? Water in the atmosphere will undergo a phase change..
Which of the following is the primary advantage of sexual reproduction when compared to asexual reproduction? There is greater genetic variety in offspring..

If a classroom experiment involves the use of several unidentified chemical solutions, which factor would be most important in maintaining safety during the experiment? The classroom would have good ventilation..
Plants need a source of energy in order to perform photosynthesis. From which source do plants receive the energy needed to perform photosynthesis? sunlight.
Which landforms are most like hills but are much taller? mountains.
Which of the following can provide the human body with long-term immunity against some diseases? vaccines.
What geographic obstacle causes water to condense in an air mass as the air mass moves? mountains.
When sunlight shines on a plant, its leaves make food..

Homes that are built to be environmentally friendly because they use energy more efficiently than other homes are called "green" homes. "Green" homes often have reflective roofs and walls made of recycled materials. The windows in these energy-saving homes are double-paned, meaning each window has two pieces of glass. Double-paned windows have a layer of air between the window panes. This layer is a barrier against extreme temperatures and saves energy. A solar panel on a "green" home uses a renewable energy source.
Which statement best identifies a basic need of all animals? They need to eat..
How does the appearance of a constellation change during the night? Its position appears to shift relative to the horizon..
Which technology used to generate electrical power involves a trade-off between economical electricity and long-term waste disposal problems? nuclear reactor.
A researcher determines a cell has a flexible cell wall composed of peptidoglycan. This observation narrows possible classifications of the cell to which taxonomic group? bacteria.
Which of the following elements is best able to combine with itself and hydrogen [H] to form large molecules? carbon [C].
Which best describes the orbit of the Moon around Earth? elliptical with a period of about one month.
A student drops a ball. Which force causes the ball to fall to the ground? gravity.
Which structure is found in producers in nearly all ecosystems? chloroplasts.
Decomposers are organisms that obtain their food from dead organisms. Which of these would be classified as decomposers? bacteria, fungi.
A teacher places an item in a box. The item takes the shape of the entire container. This item is most likely air..

Water that is used to cool nuclear power plants can be released into water bodies, causing an area called a thermal plume. A thermal plume can be 12-18°C warmer than surrounding waters. Although some fish may be attracted to the warmer water, other organisms may not be able to survive. Government officials order a study to determine the effects of a thermal plume in a water body near a nuclear power plant in North Carolina. Which factor most related to temperature should the study focus on in order to determine whether the thermal plume is damaging the health of the water system? dissolved oxygen.
Which of the following best describes an advantage of using a mass production manufacturing system instead of a custom manufacturing system? Products can be made at a lower cost..
The freezing and thawing action of water affects a rock by gradually breaking down the rock into smaller pieces..
Which of the following materials would best slow the transfer of heat? wood.
The invention of the telescope allowed which of the following to take place? detailed observation of planets.
Materials such as carbon and nitrogen go through cycles. The cycling of nitrogen waste materials is mostly dependent upon the role of which factor? bacteria.
Which sense is used to tell if there is sugar in a glass of tea? Taste.

The exotic plant Melaleuca, or Australian Pine, has increased the intensity of fires across the Everglades. The amount of fuel available for fires has increased due to the presence of the Melaleuca. The Melaleuca releases massive numbers of seeds in response to fire, drought, and herbicide damage. Which best describes the reason the Melaleuca has been able to survive? adaptation.
Which two body systems are directly involved in movement? muscular and skeletal.
Why are most fossils found in sedimentary rocks? Organisms can be preserved in sedimentary rock..
What may form as a direct result of a star collapsing? supernova.
Plants transform energy when they make their own food. Which type of energy is used by plants for making food? light.

A girl with long hair is going to be participating in an experiment that uses an alcohol burner for an energy source. What is the best thing for her to do to prepare for this experiment? tie her hair back away from her face.
Which of these describes a location where minerals are most likely to form? cooled magma from a volcano.
Cells that conduct messages are known as nerve cells.
When a hammer strikes a nail, the nail exerts an equal and opposite force back on the hammer..
In New York State, the shortest period of daylight occurs during which month? December.
To which group does an animal belong if it lays eggs and has scales and gills? fish.
Which of the following statements applies to all states of matter? Matter is made up of particles called atoms..

Thousands of years ago, several species of large mammals existed in North America. These species became extinct not long after the first human settlement of North America. Which human activity most likely contributed to the extinction of these mammals? hunting.
The main function of a duck's webbed feet is to help the duck swim in water.
The skin of a chameleon can change colors to help it blend with its surroundings. How would this adaptation most likely help a chameleon survive? by helping the chameleon hide from its predators.
On a field trip, a student holds a frog and reports that it has slippery skin. This is an example of an observation.
The axis of Earth is tilted at an angle of 23.5° from the vertical position. Which of the following is the main result of this tilt? change of seasons.
If wolves prey on deer for food, what will most likely happen to the deer population if wolves are removed from an area where deer live? The population of deer will increase..
Birds eat non-camouflaged moths at a higher rate than they eat camouflaged moths. In which situation would birds eat the moths at the slowest rate? light moths in a light environment.
Dust and ash entering the atmosphere as a result of volcanic eruptions can affect Earth's weather and climate.
Sleet, rain, snow, and hail are forms of precipitation.
Which of the following helps to produce urine in humans and other mammals? kidneys.

Scientists wonder how the Egyptian pyramids were built. They think that the huge blocks of stone may have been put into place by pushing them up a sloping pathway. The pathway is which type of simple machine? inclined plane.
Which of the following organisms have the greatest effect on an ecosystem because of the changes they make to their environment? beavers building a dam across a stream.
All of the inherited traits that are passed to offspring during asexual reproduction come from a single parent..
Which part of the body works closely with the digestive system to transport nutrients to the cells? blood.
Lichens are symbiotic organisms made of green algae and fungi. What do the green algae supply to the fungi in this symbiotic relationship? food.
Which of these resources is renewable? wind.
Which environmental problem was directly caused by the invention of the automobile? increase in air pollution.
Michelle is interested in improving the quality of the soil in her yard. She wants more water and air to penetrate the soil. What should she add to the soil to help her achieve this goal? earthworms.
When a multicellular organism is damaged, it will repair itself as the cells work together..

Students are learning about the natural resources in Maryland. One group of students researches information about renewable natural resources in the state. The other group researches information about nonrenewable natural resources in the state. The resources the students investigate include plants, animals, soil, minerals, water, coal, and oil. Aluminum is a nonrenewable natural resource. Which of these methods of aluminum disposal is best for the environment? recycling it.
Which human organ system primarily exchanges gases between the body and the atmosphere? respiratory.
Which force causes rocks to roll downhill? gravity.
If a student gets a chemical splashed into an eye, what is the most appropriate first action to be taken? flush the eye with water at an eyewash station.
A tight metal lid on a jar of pickles may loosen when it has been held in hot water. This is because the hot water causes the metal lid to expand more than the glass jar expands.
A lizard most likely would be protected from its enemies if it has which characteristic? skin color that matches its habitat.

Otto pushed a toy car across a floor. The car traveled fast across the wood, but it slowed to a stop on the carpet. Which best explains what happened when the car reached the carpet? Friction increased..
Which of the following organisms produces energy from sunlight? grass.
A function of a plant's roots is to absorb water and minerals..
How can plants most likely improve air quality? by producing oxygen.
Which best explains why a person infected with bacteria may have a fever? The body is responding to fight off the bacteria..

Wind can cause erosion that changes the surface of the Earth. Wind erosion can have negative effects on the environment by removing soil and polluting the air during dust storms. Which of the following land forms are created by wind erosion? sand dunes and arches.
When compared to current average conditions, which term would best describe conditions in Earth's lower atmosphere if greenhouse gases were absent? cooler.
In making a pizza, which process involves a chemical change? baking the dough to form the crust.
The following represents a number displayed on a calculator. 1.454545 E3. Which of the following shows how a student should record this number in a laboratory report? 1.45 x 10^3.
Which change would have the greatest negative impact on the survival of an owl species? an decrease in size of habitat.
Which interaction within an ecosystem is characterized by gradual change from one community of organisms to another? succession.
The atomic mass of an atom is the sum of protons and neutrons..
Pedro shook a can of soda. When the soda was opened, foam and soda burst from the can. Which statement best explains what happened? The gas pressure was released from the can..
The length of a year is equivalent to the time it takes for one revolution of Earth around the Sun.
Which best describes a proton? positively charged and part of the nucleus.
The periodic table provides information about the atoms of different elements. Which is a characteristic of an atom determines what element it is? number of protons.
The reading on a barometer rises when the air pressure increases..
Rocks and Earth and on the Moon are made of similar materials. What does this observation most likely suggest? The Moon was probably formed from material from Earth..
Which characteristic is not an inherited trait? personality.
Which pair together could cause a rainbow? Sunshine and rain.
A metal ball has a constant velocity of zero. Which other quantity must also be zero? acceleration of the ball.

In a laboratory activity, four different types of rock were placed in identical acid solutions for one week. Each sample was then measured to see if any of the rock mass was dissolved by the acid solution. Which is the dependent (responding) variable in this activity? the amount of dissolved rock.
Which organ removes cell waste from the blood? the kidney.
Scientists use the term "light year" to describe the distance light travels in one year..
A mountain range has hills around its edges. How are the mountains and hills alike? Both are taller than the land around them..

When a large oak tree is cut down in a forest, it leaves a gap in the forest canopy which allows smaller trees to quickly grow in the available sunlight. Which interaction is best represented among the smaller trees? competition.

In the past, wild hogs called "javelinas" were seen only in the southern part of New Mexico. Now, javelinas are seen in areas 100 miles further north. What is the most likely cause of this expansion? Environmental conditions have changed..
Which energy source is considered nonrenewable? oil.
Which a molecular process found only in retroviruses? reverse transcription.

When sodium hydroxide reacts with a copper nitrate solution, the reaction vessel needs to be kept on ice to slow down the reaction. What best describes this reaction? an exothermic reaction that releases energy.
Copernicus changed the way people viewed the solar system by claiming Earth is in orbit about the Sun..
About how often is a full moon observed from Earth's surface? once a month.

Over a long period of time, a rocky volcanic island that previously did not support any form of life got transformed into a dense forested region. Which of these species is most likely to have been the pioneer species that initiated this transformation? lichens.
In what way does society benefit from research on diseases? Many illnesses will be prevented or cured..
A decomposer is an organism that recycles nutrients.

Scientists measured the patterns of spectral lines given off by distant galaxies and concluded that almost all of these galaxies are moving away from Earth. What did the scientists observe directly? a shift toward longer wavelengths of light.
Which of the following is the best observation of the refraction of light? Viewing an object partially in water.
Which scientist studied biology by traveling by ship to different islands observing animal life, and developed a hypothesis about how species change? Charles Darwin.
Moving water was the most important factor in forming which of these? the Grand Canyon.
The most effective way to show a change happening over time is to display your results using a line graph..

The average temperature of the surface of Earth has increased approximately 1°C in the past century. Which reason best explains this increase in temperature? higher levels of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
In the life cycle of a fly, which stage comes after the larval stage? pupa.
Which would best aid a scientist in discovering how Earth may have changed over time? discovering a fossil of a seashell in a wooded area.
An organism's cells include organelles and a cell wall. In which taxonomic group or groups might the organism be classified? plants, fungi, or protists.
What would be the best source to find information about DNA testing? scientific journals.
The topography of Nevada is dominated by basins and mountain ranges associated with which geological phenomena? faults.
Which type of rock would most likely contain a fossil? sedimentary rock.
Which force keeps the planets in their orbits around the Sun? gravity.

At science conventions, scientists present their research, and members of the audience can discuss or ask questions about the research. The main value of these science conventions is that they allow scientists to exchange their ideas..
As water vapor condenses into liquid, which of the following can be formed? clouds.
Which of these structures form when materials are deposited, buried, and cemented? sedimentary rocks.
Water moves by capillary action through soil from moist areas to dry areas. Which property of water is most responsible for this capillary action? Water has a high surface tension..
Which of the following energy conversions takes place in a battery-operated flashlight? chemical -> electrical -> light.
After nitrogen becomes part of the lithosphere, what is the next change that nitrogen will undergo? fixed by bacteria in the soil.
The Mariana Trench is the deepest ocean trench on Earth. This trench occurs at a plate boundary where one plate is being forced beneath another..

During science class, students combined 1 kg of iron filings with 1 kg of sand to create a mixture. Which of the following methods would be best for separating the iron filings from the sand? Drag a magnet through the mixture to attract the iron filings..
An example of a learned behavior is a dog laying down on command..
Which process will separate the sugar from a mixture of sugar and water? Evaporating the water.
Scientists are discovering ways to make some crops use less water. A person working in which job would most benefit from this research? a farmer.

Intense heat and pressure in Earth's crust can change sandstone into quartzite. During this metamorphosis, many properties of these rocks change. Which property of these rocks will most likely remain the same? mass.
What is the highest temperature that water can reach in a pot on a stove? 100°C.
Which of these living things in a grassland ecosystem depend on the presence of a variety of bacteria and other microorganisms in the soil? all the organisms in the ecosystem.
Why do planets stay in orbit around the Sun? attraction of gravity.
Which of the following has the greatest effect on the ability of soil to hold water? the size of the soil particles.
Pollen is necessary for a flowering plant to reproduce..
An atom will always have equal numbers of protons and electrons..
Infectious diseases are caused by microorganisms.
The work of which scientist serves as the basis for many procedures used in agriculture, such as selective breeding of plants? Mendel.
In an atom, protons plus neutrons make up the atom's atomic mass..

For many years, people have been curious about the stars. In the past, people have shared what they knew about the stars through stories and drawings. Which pair of tools would be most helpful for people today to gather and share information about stars? a telescope and a computer.

Brittany pedaled her bicycle quickly on a level surface. When she stopped pedaling and coasted, the bicycle slowed and came to a stop. What happened to the energy of the moving bicycle as it coasted to a stop? It was transferred to heat due to friction..
What safety rule is most important for students to follow when working with acids and bases? put on safety goggles.
What is a large buildup of moving ice and snow called? glacier.
Which sentence describes a characteristic of offspring produced by sexual reproduction? The offspring contain genetic material from both parents..
What happens at the boiling point of a substance? liquid becomes a gas.
From smallest to largest, the levels of organization in living things are cells, tissues, organs, organ systems..
Matter that is vibrating is producing ___. sound.
Which of these converts electrical energy to light energy? a flashlight.

A student put 200 milliliters (mL) of water into a pot, sets the pot on a burner, and heats the water to boil. When the pot is taken off the burner, it contains only 180 milliliters (mL) of water. What happened to the rest of the water? It turned into water vapor..
Sleet and hail are forms of precipitation.
Humans need food to grow and survive. Food that is not used immediately by the body for energy is stored for future use.
Which group of organisms can show significant trait changes in the shortest period of time? bacteria.
About how many Earth days does it take the Moon to travel around Earth? 27.
Why do satellites and spacecraft launched from Earth need to reach a specific speed to escape Earth's surface? to overcome Earth's gravitational force.
An athlete is running a race. The athlete's body needs energy. Which organelle(s) in the athlete's cells supply the energy for cellular functions? mitochondrion.
Which of the following is visible through a reflecting telescope? moons around Jupiter.
Carlos puts a new battery into a radio. What does the battery supply to the radio that makes it turn on? electricity.
A glacier sometimes leaves behind large chunks of ice. What is left in the ground when these chunks of ice melt? a kettle.
Living things are classified as producers or consumers according to how they obtain food.
Which behavior is a learned behavior? eating with a fork.
